2. Heard Sri Ashish Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Sunil Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.
3. Applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.50 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 304B I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Bahsuma, District Meerut, during the pendency of trial.
4.
As per prosecution story, the marriage of the applicant was solemnized with the deceased person as per Hindu Rites on 18.04.2018.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The FIR is delayed by more than one day and there is no explanation of the said delay caused.
The cause of death was found to be poison as aluminum phosphide chemical was found in her viscera.
The applicant after learning about attempt to commit suicide, he rushed the decease to hospital but she could not survive.
6. Learned counsel for the applicant has further stated that the deceased had two children out of said wedlock and, as such, there was no occasion for the applicant to administer poison to her.
It is a clear-cut case of suicide.
There is no criminal history of the applicant.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 19.03.2024 and he is ready to cooperate with trial.

In case, the applicant is released on bail,
he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
7. Learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the bail application.

8.Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, the evidence on record, taking into consideration the delay in institution of FIR and the applicant having rushed the deceased to hospital and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

9. Let the applicant-Joni, who is involved in aforementioned case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with evidence during trial.
(ii) The applicant shall not pressurise/intimidate with the prosecution witnesses.
(iii) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed.
10. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

11. It is made clear that observations made in granting bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
